proposals.evidence: Turner 12646 explicitly records Pashai Darrai susuwā́ and Wegali sosəwá dry under śōṣu. Lehr Darrai sos- has the same s-s dry stem; its shorter lexical-stem notation is retained, without importing Turner’s adjectival ending.

assignments.Notes: Turner 12646 explicitly records Pashai Darrai susuwā́ and Wegali sosəwá dry under śōṣu. Lehr Darrai sos- has the same s-s dry stem; its shorter lexical-stem notation is retained, without importing Turner’s adjectival ending. Lehr Darrai Pashai dry and flee

proposals.evidence: Turner 10181 explicitly records Pashai muč- to flee and fall of a star under mucyátē escapes, alongside Ashkun muč- escape/flee. Lehr Darrai muc- flee matches the stem and meaning directly.
